question.text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
question.resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve as the midpoint of the guidance range for Q4 FY2027 as stated in NVIDIA’s “Outlook” section of its Q3 FY2027 earnings press release, expected to be published on [NVIDIA’s investor relations site](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/) and the [SEC’s EDGAR system](https://www.sec.gov/) on November 17, 2026.

The unit value for revenues is billions of U.S. dollars, and it will be rounded to the nearest billion. GAAP gross margin will be rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent. GAAP operating expenses are in a unit value of billions of U.S. dollars and will be rounded to the nearest tenth of a billion dollars.
question.fine_print:
* If a single figure (not a range) is provided, that figure will be used.
* If multiple ranges or scenarios are presented, the primary range specified in the official “Outlook” or “Guidance” section will be used to resolve the subquestions.
* If NVIDIA does not issue guidance for Q4 FY2027 in the Q3 FY2027 release, the corresponding subquestion will be **annulled**.
* Only the originally published figure will be used; subsequent updates, corrections, or guidance revisions will be ignored.

research:
I'm researching NVIDIA's Q4 FY2027 revenue guidance. Here is what I found.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the midpoint of the "Outlook" revenue figure in the Q3 FY2027 press release, due 2026-11-17 at about 1:20 pm PT, with the call at 2 pm PT. That release has not been published yet. [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm)
- 2026-08-26: The latest outlook in effect is for Q3: $108.0B ±2%, assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China. Q2 revenue was $96.2B (up 18% from Q1, up 106% year over year). Data Center revenue was $89.0B. [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027)
- NVIDIA always gives a single midpoint with "plus or minus 2%", so the midpoint is simply the headline figure.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The 2026-11-12 CEO-transition 8-K contains no financial guidance. It only says "operations, customer commitments and product roadmap [will] continue without interruption." [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm)
- Kalshi puts the chance that the earnings call is postponed at 4%.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-13: Analyst previews put Q3 revenue consensus at about $108.4B to $109.3B, depending on the data provider (FactSet $108.72B, Koyfin $109.01B, Visible Alpha $109.3B). The Q3 EPS estimate is $2.47. [StoneX](https://www.stonex.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/nvidia-earnings-preview-nvda-s-first-test-of-the-post-jenson-huang-era/), [Borsainside](https://www.borsainside.com/news/nvidia-trimestrale-novembre-2026-ricavi-datacenter-huang-previsioni/)
- 2026-11-13: Wedbush reportedly expects Q4 guidance of **$124B to $130B**, with the midpoint about $2B above consensus. This implies Street Q4 consensus of roughly $125B. I could not read the original note because the Futu page didn't load, so this comes from search summaries. [Futu](https://news.futunn.com/en/post/1004479711/wedbush-nvidia-s-quarterly-revenue-expected-to-beat-estimates-as)
- A search summary cited a Yahoo Finance next-quarter estimate of about $124.7B revenue and $2.75 EPS. I could not confirm this.
- 2026-11-13: Anonymous-source reports say Kress opposed Huang's large OpenAI financing backstops. On the August call she said OpenAI commitments totaled about 12 GW through 2030, and that labs backed by NVIDIA's balance sheet would be about a quarter of the business. An analyst said backstop standards had already tightened over the prior roughly three months. Tighter terms are a possible downside risk to the guide. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/13/nvidias-new-ceo-colette-kress-seems-tougher-on-openai-than-huang-was/)
- 2026-11-12: Jensen Huang resigned after reports of affairs. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and stays CFO. Harvey Jones was named chair. [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm)
- 2026-11-12: The stock closed at $166.19, more than 30% below its 2026-10-06 close of $239.24. [Invezz](https://invezz.com/nl/nieuws/2026/11/13/nvidia-kwartaalcijfers-wat-te-verwachten-nu-kress-eerste-test-zonder-huang-krijgt/)
- 2026-08-26: The CFO said FY2028 revenue should grow about 70%, against Street expectations of about 44%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/26/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q2-2027-live-updates.html)

## 4. Base rates
The table compares each quarter's guidance midpoint, actual revenue and the next guide given with those results.

| Quarter | Guide midpoint | Actual | Next guide | Next guide ÷ actual | Next guide minus prior guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q3 FY26 | 54 | ~57.0 | 65 | 1.14 | +11 |
| Q4 FY26 | 65 | ~68.1 | 78 | 1.145 | +13 |
| Q1 FY27 | 78 | 81.6 | 91 | 1.115 | +13 |
| Q2 FY27 | 91 | 96.2 | 108 | 1.123 | +17 |

- Sources: [Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/02/25/nvidia-nvda-earnings-q4-results-jensen-huang/), [NVIDIA Q1](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027), [NVIDIA Q2](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027). The FY26 actuals are approximate, from memory and press reports.
- Actual revenue has beaten the guide midpoint by about $3B to $5B (4% to 6%) each quarter.
- The next guide has been about 11.5% to 14.5% above the latest actual, and $11B to $17B above the previous guide. The step-up has been growing.
- Two illustrative calculations, not forecasts:
  - If Q3 comes in at $110B to $113B and the usual 11.5% to 14.5% markup holds, the Q4 guide would be about $123B to $129B.
  - Adding the past $11B to $17B step-ups to $108B gives $119B to $125B.
- Seasonality: the January quarter has not been seasonally weak in recent years. Q3 to Q4 guide step-ups were +$11B (FY26) and, from memory, about +$5.5B (FY25, a $32.5B guide versus $37.5B), both driven by data center supply ramps rather than the calendar.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on NVIDIA's Q4 revenue guidance.
- Related Polymarket market on Q3 Data Center revenue (2026-11-14):
  - Above $105B: 54.5%
  - Above $110B: 27%
  - Above $100B: 97%

  This implies a median of about $105B to $106B for Data Center, which points to total Q3 revenue of about $112B to $114B. Q2 non-Data Center revenue was about $7.2B.
- Polymarket puts Q3 non-GAAP gross margin at 73% to 75% with 85.5% probability.
- Analysts: Wedbush expects $124B to $130B (midpoint about $127B). Consensus appears to be about $124.7B to $125B, but this is unverified.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17: The Q3 FY2027 release (about 1:20 pm PT) and call (2 pm PT) settle the question. Forecasts close earlier, at 11:00 UTC that day.
- Risks to watch:
  - Guidance style under the new leadership, possibly more conservative.
  - OpenAI financing terms.
  - Any China assumption change; recent outlooks have excluded China.
  - Vera Rubin production ramp, with shipments starting in Q3.
  - Possible further Huang-related disclosures. Polymarket gives 20% to a fourth affair being reported by November 20.
- 2026-11-18: Kress has an all-hands meeting scheduled, after resolution.

- In the four most recent guides, NVIDIA beat its guide midpoint each quarter and issued every guide above the prior consensus. For example, the Q2 guide was $91B against an LSEG consensus of $86.8B.
- Simple arithmetic on these figures, not a forecast:
  - Applying the last four multiples (1.115 to 1.145) to a Q3 actual of $109-114B gives about $122-131B.
  - Applying the 1.17-1.20 step to the prior guide gives about $126-130B.
- Older exception: the Q2 FY26 guide of $45B was barely above the prior actual of $44.1B because of the China H20 restrictions.

  - Further fallout from the Huang scandal. Polymarket gives 20% to a fourth reported affair by Nov 20.
  - Memory supply and cost pressure.
  - How fast Rubin supply ramps.
  - China remains excluded from guidance.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 3 days. The Q3 FY2027 release is due 2026-11-17 at about 1:20 pm PT. Forecasts close earlier, at 11:00 UTC that day.

(b) **Latest known value:** On 2026-08-26 NVIDIA guided Q3 FY2027 revenue to $108.0B ±2%. Q2 actual revenue was $96.2B.

(c) **If nothing changed:** A flat guide of about $108B is very unlikely. NVIDIA has raised its guide every quarter.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- Actuals have beaten the guide by 4% to 6%, so Q3 should come in at about $112B to $114B. The Polymarket Data Center market implies roughly the same.
- The next guide has been 11.5% to 14.5% above the latest actual. That gives about $125B to $130B.
- The step-ups over the prior guide have been growing (+11, +13, +13, +17), which points to about $126B to $128B.

(e) **Historical variation:** Guide-to-guide steps have ranged from $11B to $17B over the last four quarters. Applied to $108B, that range alone spans about $119B to $125B. The actual-times-markup method gives a higher range.

(f) **Experts and markets:**
- Street Q4 consensus appears to be about $124.7B to $125B, but this is unverified.
- Wedbush reportedly expects $124B to $130B, with a midpoint around $127B.
- There is no direct market on the Q4 guide.
- The Polymarket Data Center market implies a strong Q3 beat.
